profiles.name: The scenic route
profiles.description: Warm cinematic lighting and long vistas, with restrained generation while the laptop also hosts the server.

settings.Client maximum heap: 6 GiB (6144 MiB); owner-selected for the shared host test
settings.DH distance starting target: 128 chunks; reduce if frametimes or cache growth suffer
settings.Background generation target: 2 worker threads, low-impact preset; verify exact generated keys
settings.Shader: Complementary Reimagined; BSL and Unbound selectable after validation
settings.LOD cache budget: 4 GiB per test world; stop managed generation before exhaustion
settings.Dynamic lighting: Optional; evaluate with shaders and moving contraptions
settings.Weather particles: Conservative counts until severe-weather benchmark passes
settings.DH horizontal detail: HIGH, finest resolution BLOCK; KG local Native64 check, radius128 unchanged

profiles.validation: KG Native64 distant views observed59/30/58/60FPS (30right after moving); not a sustained benchmark, shader acceptance or Sera measurement. Existing caches retained.

profiles.name: A gentler pace
profiles.description: Conservative rendering defaults. Keep the same shared gameplay pack, then tune locally after measuring Sera's computer.

settings.Client maximum heap: Start with 4 GiB if system RAM permits; do not assume an 8 GiB allocation is safe
settings.Shader: Off initially; enable BSL or Complementary low only after measurement
settings.Weather particles: Reduced local density; no competing fog mod

profiles.validation: Candidate settings. Sera's hardware and actual client performance have not been observed.
